title: Manufacturing, storing, selling, distributing or importing spurious goods causing grievous hurt
description: Manufacturing, storing, selling, distributing or importing spurious goods causing injury resulting in grievous hurt to the consumer

content.offence: Manufactures for sale or stores or sells or distributes or imports any spurious goods causing injury resulting in grievous hurt to the consumer
content.punishment: Imprisonment for a term which may extend to seven years and with fine which may extend to five lakh rupees

aliases: counterfeit goods resulting in severe harm
fake products leading to grievous harm
